I would like to share my sincere and heartfelt gratitude to Sara’s Elderly Care / Vriddhashram for the wonderful care they provided to my father. He was on dialysis and dealing with multiple age-related health issues, and it had become extremely difficult for us to manage everything at home.

From the very first day, the team showed compassion, professionalism, and genuine concern for his well-being. The caregivers were patient and attentive, ensuring he received his medications and dialysis-related support on time. They kept us informed regularly and treated my father with the dignity and respect he deserved.

A special mention to Rahul Singh and Vicky, who cared for him with exceptional compassion, patience, and dedication. They consistently made sure his needs were met and went beyond routine care—spending time with him, comforting him, and helping him feel at home during a very challenging phase of his life. My father passed away while under their care, and during that incredibly difficult time, Rahul went above and beyond to help us. He assisted in arranging the necessary documentation and coordinated the transfer to the crematory. His calm presence and willingness to manage these responsibilities made an overwhelming situation a little easier for us to navigate.

The entire team at Sara’s Elderly Care treated my father with respect, warmth, and humanity, and for that I am truly grateful. Losing a parent is never easy, but knowing he was looked after by people who genuinely cared brought us comfort.

I would wholeheartedly recommend Sara’s Elderly Care to anyone seeking a responsible, compassionate, and trustworthy place for their loved ones.

featured_reviews.name: Rossie Ayem
featured_reviews.review_text: Two years ago, I was looking out for an old age home for my aged maternal uncle who was an unmarried free spirited individual and who was always comfortable living on his own. I searched throughout the western suburbs, looking out for an institution who acutally cared for the aged instead of inflating their profits. I visited many old age homes but was unhappy with them in many ways. Some were unclean, others were interested in making money and most of them really didn't care about the aged. What I noticed upon my visits was that most of these so called old age homes were just ordinary day-to-day service providers, trying to get a job done at the end of the day and make money out of it. Then a friend suggested I vist Mercy John Memorial Public Trust which had an old age home in Mira Road east run by Mr. John Mathew and his daughter Mrs. Sheba John. Upon my visit I was indeed suprised. Of all the old age homes that I had visited so far, this one had a complete satisfying aura about it right from the beginning. It was absolutely clean and hyegine standards were uncompromised. I met the owners Mr. John Mathew and his daughter Mrs. Sheba John, who made me feel at home and took me on a tour of the old age home. They have a kitchen which follows high hyegine protocol. They have individual accommodation, geriatric care unit, common wards etc with excellent inhouse medical facilities. They even have an palliative care unit which helps the aged with their illnesses & chronic conditions and manages their symptoms and improves their quality of life. Most importantly above all else, the owners & staff take care of the patients/inmates in the most loving, empathic and compassionate manner, unlike other old age homes that I have visited. They indeed make the patients/inmates feel at home. A paramount point to note is that the owners Mr. John Mathew and his daughter Mrs. Sheba John are extremely kind, emphatic & supportive and take personal day-to-day interest in the patients/inmates, looking into their well-being & their daily needs. In no other old age home have I ever seen the owners take this amount of personal interest in their patients/inmates. There are also cultural programmes held in festive seasons for the patients/inmates. In short, it's a complete home away from home! My uncle departed for his heavenly abode a month ago but in his short stay of 2 years at Mercy John Memorial Public Trust was a blissful and satisfying one, where all his need were taken care of. In these 2 years, I have seen my uncle smiling, happy and living his life maximum to his free spirited self. When he departed, he was indeed a happy and content soul. Above all, he was given respect, love, empathy and compassion by the staff and the owners of the old age home. I truly thank the owners Mr. John Mathew & his daughter Mrs. Sheba John and their staff for taking such excellent care of my uncle and above all, treating him like a member of their own family. In my list of recommendations, Mercy John Memorial Public Trust takes the top spot any day!
